## Installation

You can install the development version of pruebapaquetes from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Maxi121207/pruebapaquetes")
```

## Example

El objetivo de este paquete es proporcionar a los usuarios distintos tipos de suma, para su uso diario.

```{r example}
library(pruebapaquetes)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`? You can include R chunks like so:

```{r}
mi_funcion(1,5)
```

```{r}
mi_funcion(6,7)
```

```{r}
mi_funcion(9,11)
```

```{r}
mi_funcion(1003,44023)
```

```{r}
mi_funcion(-122,-432)
```
```
You'll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md` up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo = FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

In that case, don't forget to commit and push the resulting figure files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.
